# M Gas (mgas.ir) - Official Manufacturer & Exporter of LPG Cylinders

> M Gas (مدیریت آقای موسی عمویی - تاسیس ۱۳۴۹) is a specialized industrial manufacturer and global exporter of LPG (Liquefied Petroleum Gas) cylinders, picnic camping gas bottles, and automotive LPG tanks conforming to national and international standards (ISO 9001, EN 1442).

## Core Capabilities & Specifications
- **Product Range**: 0.5L, 1L, 1.5L, 3L, 5L, 8L, 10L, 11L (standard home 11kg), 25L, 33L, 45L, 50L (heavy industrial 50kg), and 60L automotive toroidal/cylindrical LPG tanks.
- **Safety Testing**: 100% 30-bar hydrostatic water pressure testing, radiography of welded joints, burst testing.
- **Surface Treatment**: Automated shot blasting & electrostatic polyester powder coating (RAL standard colors).
- **Export Logistics**: Optimized container stacking for 20ft and 40ft HQ shipping containers with global export documentation.
